data.summary: Kapa.ai, a Y Combinator S23 startup, is seeking a full-stack software engineer (EU remote) to work on their AI assistant platform. The role involves scaling the infrastructure for Kapa's RAG engine, experimenting with new features in their analytics platform, and maintaining client integrations. Applicants should have a degree in computer science or related fields, 3+ years of experience in complex systems, and an affinity for machine learning, deep learning, and NLP. Kapa enables technical companies to build AI support and onboarding bots using their existing content.
